title: OakRTB OpenRTB 2.6
description: OakRTB JSON Schema for BidRequest/BidResponse (IAB OpenRTB 2.6-202606 field names). OakRTB profile: BidRequest requires at+cur; BidResponse requires cur. Extra fields allowed via additionalProperties / ext.
$comment: OakRTB protocol 0.2.0, aligned with IAB OpenRTB 2.6-202606. Validation authority for JSON; protobuf is codec-only. See docs/spec.md.

Ext.title: Extension object
Ext.description: Exchange- or bidder-specific extensions. Any object may include ext.

AuctionType.description: 1 = first price, 2 = second price plus, >=500 exchange-specific. Deal.at may also be 3 (fixed price).

value.description: Metric value, typically a probability or ratio in 0-1.

vendor.description: Measurement provider, such as IAS, MOAT or publisher measurement.

wratio.description: Width ratio; together with hratio defines the aspect ratio.

wmin.description: Minimum width in device-independent pixels (DIPs) for flexible layouts.

format.description: Accepted sizes for flexible/multi-size placements; takes precedence over standalone w/h.

w.description: Width in device-independent pixels (DIPs) for fixed-size banners, paired with h.

battr.description: Blocked creative attributes (CreativeAttribute): 1-18 as defined in the enum, >=500 vendor-specific; for example, blocking autoplay audio.

mimes.description: Supported MIME types, such as image/jpeg, image/png or text/javascript.

topframe.description: Top-frame flag (FlagBool): 0=inside iframe, 1=top frame; relevant to expansion or escaping the frame.

id.description: Banner ID for correlating multiple video companion banners.

vcm.description: Video companion mode (VideoCompanionMode): 0=concurrent with video, 1=end card after completion.

mindur.description: Minimum interval duration in seconds, inclusive.

maxdur.description: Maximum interval duration in seconds, inclusive; omit for no upper bound.

bidfloor.description: CPM floor for this duration interval.

mimes.description: Supported video MIME types. Required; for example video/mp4 or video/webm.

minduration.description: Minimum duration in seconds; filters creatives that are too short.

maxduration.description: Maximum duration in seconds; filters creatives that are too long.

startdelay.description: Start delay in seconds: 0=pre-roll, -1=generic mid-roll, -2=post-roll, >0=mid-roll after that many seconds.

maxseq.description: Maximum ads within a pod, defining CTV ad-pod capacity.

poddur.description: Total pod duration in seconds, shared by its ads.

protocols.description: Supported video protocols (Protocol): 1-3=VAST1-3, 4-6=corresponding wrappers, 7-8=VAST4, 9-10=DAAST, 11-16=VAST4.1-4.3 and wrappers.

podid.description: Ad pod ID, shared by Imps within the same dynamic pod for scheduling.

rqddurs.description: Required exact durations in seconds, such as standard 15s/30s creatives.

plcmt.description: Video placement type replacing placement (VideoPlcmt): 1=instream, 2=accompanying content, 3=interstitial, 4=no content, 5=pause, 6=screensaver, 7=overlay, 8=squeezeback, 9=in-scene.

skip.description: Skippable flag (FlagBool): 0=not skippable, 1=skippable; distinguishes skippable and non-skippable pre-roll.

skipmin.description: Minimum video duration in seconds for skipping to be allowed.

skipafter.description: Seconds before the skip button appears.

mincpmpersec.description: Minimum CPM per second for duration-based floor pricing.

battr.description: Blocked creative attributes (CreativeAttribute): 1-18 as defined in the enum; >=500 vendor-specific.

maxextended.description: Maximum seconds beyond maxduration; -1 means unlimited.

boxingallowed.description: Letterboxing allowed (FlagBool): 0=no, 1=yes; permits black bars for mismatched aspect ratios.

playbackmethod.description: Playback method (PlaybackMethod): 1=load/sound on, 2=load/muted, 3=click/sound on, 4=hover/sound on, 5=viewport/sound on, 6=viewport/muted, 7=continuous.

playbackend.description: Playback cessation (PlaybackCessationMode): 1=completion/user, 2=leave viewport/user, 3=float after leaving viewport until completion.

companionad.description: Companion banner specifications, such as banners beside or below a video.

poddedupe.description: Pod deduplication policy (OpenRTB 2.6-202402+); see AdCOM Pod Deduplication. Pod deduplication (OpenRTB 2.6-202402+, PodDeduplication): 1=adomain, 2=IAB Content Taxonomy, 3=creative ID, 4=mediafile URL; multiple values allowed.

durfloors.description: Duration-based floor tiers. Duration-based floor tiers, such as different CPM floors for 15s/30s creatives.

protocols.description: Audio protocols (Protocol), including DAAST 9/10 and VAST; see enum.

startdelay.description: Start delay, as in Video: 0=pre-roll, -1=mid-roll, -2=post-roll, >0=mid-roll delay in seconds.

mincpmpersec.description: Minimum CPM per second for duration-based floor pricing.

maxextended.description: Maximum seconds beyond maxduration; -1 means unlimited.

request.description: Required Native request JSON string, including assets[]; validate against Native 1.2.

ver.description: Native specification version, such as "1.2", indicating which markup version the DSP should parse.

battr.description: Blocked creative attributes; see CreativeAttribute enum.

id.description: Required Deal ID, echoed in Bid.dealid for a deal bid.

at.description: Deal auction type (AuctionType): 1=first price, 2=second price plus, 3=fixed price, >=500=custom; overrides BidRequest.at.

guar.description: Guaranteed flag (FlagBool): 0=no, 1=guaranteed Deal; used for programmatic guaranteed delivery.

mincpmpersec.description: Minimum CPM per second for duration-priced video.

durfloors.description: Duration-based floor tiers for video/audio deals.

private_auction.description: Private-auction flag (FlagBool): 0=open market permitted, 1=private only; used for closed PDB trading.

deals.description: Available deal terms; one Imp may offer multiple Deals for DSP selection.

multiplier.description: Quantity multiplier relative to one standard impression.

RefSettings.description: Imp.refresh.refsettings[] entry. Refresh count lives on Refresh.count, not here.

minint.description: Minimum refresh interval in seconds, limiting refresh frequency.

count.description: Refresh count since the last full page load.

id.description: Required ID, unique within the request. Bid.impid must reference this value.

metric.description: Inventory quality or verification metrics, such as third-party viewability or video completion rates.

banner.description: Display ad specifications for banners, rich media or interstitial images.

video.description: Video ad specifications for pre-/mid-/post-roll, rewarded video or CTV pods.

audio.description: Audio ad specifications for podcasts, radio streams or music apps.

native.description: Native ad specifications for feed cards; request embeds Native 1.2 JSON.

pmp.description: Private marketplace data for PDB/PD/Preferred Deals, including deals[].

displaymanager.description: Rendering SDK/player name, used to identify mediation/player compatibility.

displaymanagerver.description: displaymanager version, for SDK-version rollout and troubleshooting.

instl.description: Interstitial/fullscreen flag (FlagBool): 0=no, 1=yes; used for pricing and experience policies.

tagid.description: Publisher placement ID for optimization, reporting and floor policies.

bidfloor.description: CPM floor; bids below this price are generally invalid.

bidfloorcur.description: Floor currency (ISO-4217), paired with bidfloor; commonly defaults to USD.

clickbrowser.description: Click destination behavior (FlagBool): 0=embedded WebView, 1=external browser; relevant to mobile landing pages and attribution.

secure.description: HTTPS requirement (FlagBool): 0=no, 1=creative and page must use HTTPS; relevant to mixed-content restrictions.

iframebuster.description: Supported iframe-buster vendor names for rich media that can escape an iframe.

rwdd.description: Rewarded ad flag (FlagBool): 0=no reward, 1=reward for viewing the ad; applies across creative formats.

ssai.description: Ad insertion mode (Ssai): 0=unknown, 1=client-side, 2=server-side, 3=hybrid; used for CTV/live SSAI.

exp.description: Suggested impression expiry in seconds; bounds creative caching during long sessions.

qty.description: Quantity multiplier for DOOH/group impressions, converting to billable impression volume.

dt.description: Estimated seconds until display; defines the window for early auctions.

refresh.description: Automatic refresh details for rotating in-page placements.

id.description: Publisher ID for reporting and contracts.

cat.description: Producer categories; see cattax for the taxonomy.

id.description: Content ID identifying a series/article for contextual targeting.

genre.description: Legacy free-text genre; prefer genres plus gtax when a taxonomy is available.

gtax.description: Genre taxonomy (OpenRTB 2.6-202501+); IAB guidance may treat the default as Content Taxonomy 3.1. Genre taxonomy (OpenRTB 2.6-202501+) interpreting genres[]; default may follow IAB Content Taxonomy conventions.

genres.description: Genre IDs using the taxonomy specified by gtax (OpenRTB 2.6-202501+).

cat.description: Content categories; see cattax for the taxonomy.

realtime.description: Real-time flag (OpenRTB 2.6-202606): 0=not real-time, such as replay; 1=real-time, such as a live event.

firstbroadcast.description: Premiere flag (OpenRTB 2.6-202606): 0=not first showing, 1=first broadcast to the audience.

domain.description: Primary domain, such as example.com, for brand safety and blocking.

page.description: Full page URL for contextual targeting.

search.description: Search terms, when arriving from search results.

bundle.description: Package name/bundle ID, central to app targeting and blocking.

cat.description: App categories for industry targeting; taxonomy is specified by cattax.

publisher.description: Publisher entity responsible for distributing the app.

content.description: In-app content metadata, such as embedded player or article context.

venue.description: Legacy numeric venue type; prefer venuetype plus venuetypetax.

venuetype.description: Venue type IDs, such as OpenOOH; venuetypetax specifies the taxonomy.

venuetypetax.description: Venue taxonomy from AdCOM DOOH Venue Taxonomies; default 1.

content.description: Context of the content currently playing.

country.description: Country code using ISO-3166-1 Alpha-3 or an agreed convention.

source.description: SUA source (UserAgentSource): 0=unknown, 1=low-entropy CH, 2=high-entropy CH, 3=parsed UA string.

geo.description: Device location, which may differ from User.geo.

ua.description: Raw User-Agent string, used as a parsing fallback.

sua.description: Structured UA (SUA), preferred over ua for precise targeting.

ip.description: IPv4 address for geolocation and risk assessment.

pxratio.description: Ratio of physical pixels to device-independent pixels (DIPs).

geofetch.description: Whether the creative may obtain location (FlagBool): 0=no, 1=yes.

ifa.description: Advertising ID, such as IDFA/GAID, for user targeting and attribution.

source.description: ID source domain/system, such as uidapi.com.

mm.description: Match method (IdMatchMethod): 0=unknown, 1=unmatched direct cookie/IFA, 2=browser cookie sync, 3=authenticated, 4=first-party observation, 5=inferred; >=500 vendor-specific.

buyeruid.description: Buyer cookie/mapped ID, important for DSP frequency capping.

customdata.description: Buyer-defined opaque data returned by the exchange.

geo.description: User home/registration location, which may differ from Device.geo.

consent.description: Consent string, such as GDPR TCF.

eids.description: Extended/unified identities, such as UID2 or Living Docs.

nodes.description: Ordered resale nodes from origin to the current seller.

fd.description: Upstream final decision flag (FlagBool): 0=this exchange decides, 1=upstream decides.

pchain.description: Legacy payment ID chain; prefer schain.

impid.description: Required reference to Imp.id; unmatched bids are discarded by the exchange.

price.description: Required CPM bid price, strictly greater than zero; currency is BidResponse.cur.

nurl.description: Win notice URL, optionally containing ${AUCTION_PRICE}; called by the exchange server after a win.

burl.description: Billing notice URL, called at the actual billing event, which may differ from display time.

lurl.description: Loss notice URL for feedback and learning on unsuccessful bids.

adm.description: Ad markup (HTML/VAST/Native JSON, etc.). Inline markup is strongly recommended; nurl retrieval is also possible.

adid.description: Advertiser-side ad ID for ad-level reporting.

adomain.description: Advertiser domains. Strongly recommended for badv checks and brand disclosure.

bundle.description: Promoted app bundle, such as for app-install ads.

iurl.description: Sample creative preview image URL for review and quality assurance.

crid.description: Creative ID. Strongly recommended for review, frequency capping and rejection troubleshooting.

tactic.description: Tactic ID for internal DSP strategy attribution.

attr.description: Creative attributes; see CreativeAttribute enum; >=500 vendor-specific.

dealid.description: Selected Deal.id; a corresponding deal is required for PMP bids.

w.description: Actual creative width in device-independent pixels (DIPs).

h.description: Actual creative height in device-independent pixels (DIPs).

wratio.description: Creative width ratio for native/flexible layouts.

mtype.description: Creative format (MarkupType): 1=Banner, 2=Video, 3=Audio, 4=Native; required by BidCheck for multi-format Imps. JSON Schema forbids zero; protobuf UNSPECIFIED=0 means unset. Set 1-4 before emitting an explicit mtype in JSON.

slotinpod.description: Requested pod slot (SlotInPod); special value -1=last slot; used for CTV pod bidding.

bid.description: Bids for this seat; at least one is needed for a meaningful entry.

seat.description: Buyer seat name, distinguishing pricing and settlement for DSPs with multiple seats.

group.description: Group flag (FlagBool): 0=partial wins allowed, 1=all bids must win together; used for bundled Imp sales.

id.description: Unique auction ID. Required. BidResponse.id must echo it unchanged for reconciliation and log correlation.

imp.description: Impression opportunities for sale. Required and nonempty; a request may include multiple placements or formats.

site.description: Site inventory, mutually exclusive with app/dooh; used for desktop and mobile web placements.

app.description: App inventory, mutually exclusive with site/dooh; used for iOS/Android in-app ads.

dooh.description: Digital out-of-home inventory, mutually exclusive with site/app; used for DOOH screens and billboards.

device.description: Device and environment. Strongly recommended for targeting, fraud detection and creative size/OS compatibility.

user.description: User/audience. Recommended for frequency capping, audience targeting and consent/eids signals.

test.description: Test mode (FlagBool): 0=production, 1=test. Test traffic is for integration and must not be billed.

at.description: Auction type. Required. AuctionType: 1=first price, 2=second price plus, 3=fixed price (Deal only), >=500=exchange-specific. Defines how the DSP interprets the winning price. Schema/builders reject zero (unspecified).

allOf.description: Required: 1 first price, 2 second price plus, or >=500 exchange-specific. Fixed price (3) is only valid for Deal.at.

tmax.description: Timeout in milliseconds, including network time. The DSP must respond within tmax; otherwise the exchange treats it as 204.

wseat.description: Allowed seats; only listed buyer seats may participate.

allimps.description: Whether all Imps are included (FlagBool): 0=no, 1=yes. Supports global budget and exclusivity decisions.

cur.description: Accepted bid currencies (ISO-4217). Required and nonempty; DSPs must not use unlisted currencies.

wlang.description: Allowed creative languages (ISO-639-1) for language targeting.

wlangb.description: Allowed creative languages (BCP-47), providing more detail than wlang.

acat.description: Allowed advertiser industry categories for category-restricted inventory.

bcat.description: Blocked advertiser industry categories for brand safety and category exclusion.

cattax.description: Category taxonomy: CategoryTaxonomy values 1-7 are defined in the enum; >=500 are vendor-specific. Interprets cat/bcat/acat.

badv.description: Blocked advertiser domains, such as competitors or sensitive domains.

bapp.description: Blocked app bundles/package names; excludes specified advertiser apps on app inventory.

source.description: Upstream source and supply chain, for schain transparency and header-bidding audits.

regs.description: Regulatory and privacy signals for COPPA/GDPR/CCPA/GPP decisions.

ext.description: Extension JSON object string for exchange-specific fields agreed by both parties.

seatbid.description: Seat bids; an actual bid response includes at least one SeatBid.

bidid.description: Bidder-generated response ID for bidder-side logging and reconciliation.

cur.description: Required response currency (ISO-4217). Builders default to USD; it must be allowed by the request cur list.

customdata.description: Opaque data returned to the exchange and potentially included later in User.customdata.

nbr.description: No-bid reason (NoBidReason): 0=unknown error, 1=technical error, 2=invalid request, 3=crawler, 4=non-human, 5=cloud/proxy IP, 6=unsupported device, 7=blocked publisher, 8=unmatched user, 9=daily reader cap, 10=daily domain cap; >=500 custom.

$comment: This file is a catalog of $defs. Validate payloads against bid-request.schema.json or bid-response.schema.json.
